why_separate: In 2026Q2 Novo Nordisk relabels the line 'Ozempic pill / Rybelsus' after re-branding Rybelsus as Ozempic pill; the gold series is Rybelsus as printed through 2026Q1.
notes: Supersedes the plain companion novo_ozempic_pill_rybelsus already in gold (same row, same URL, no continuation block): this file is that companion with the continuation block added, and carries the same benchmark_identity so promotion replaces it instead of adding a second companion. The relabelled line runs on from the Rybelsus line with the same worldwide scope; the Q2 2026 report states 'Sales of Ozempic pill/Rybelsus increased by 7% at CER in Q2 2026, driven by the re-branding and re-launch of Ozempic pill and related wholesaler pipeline fill'. Reported and adjusted sales are both 5,228 (no 340B reversal in the quarter).
